seriesAnalysis.opponentPatterns: All five reports list CLEAR as each opponent's most frequent action (Feyenoord 42/49, Hallucination FC2 43/54, FC Zukko 38/48, Human Override Disab 28/31, FC RAM 46/54). Repeated report labels do not prove one shared tactic or successful defensive clears.
seriesAnalysis.tacticalReview: The team went 3W/2L, 6:4 goals and 9 points. It had more shots overall (23:20) and on-target shots (6:4), but losses were both 0 shots on target: Human Override Disab 4:2 shots and 0:1 target; FC RAM 5:9 and 0:2. In the four coherent command reports, MOVE shares were 74% vs Feyenoord, 65% vs Hallucination FC2, 62% vs Human Override Disab and 78% vs FC RAM; the 0-1 defeat's report had 193 MOVE commands and no SHOOT label, while the 0-2 report had 11 SHOOT commands but 0 targets. This suggests measure shot quality and decision-to-attempt mapping, not simply increase SHOOT or reduce MOVE. FC Zukko's anomalous own breakdown is excluded.
seriesAnalysis.latencyReview: Our comparable averages were 73, 75, 1590 and 75ms (median75; mean453.25 across four), while FC Zukko's 2ms report was internally inconsistent. The 1590ms match aligns with one defeat but no causal or timeout attribution is established. Opponent averages were 14-19ms, but their FWD5 latency ranged 70-83ms. The <=10ms target is unmet.
seriesAnalysis.decision: Batch18 completed on the unchanged baseline. Rank remained 12; points rose by 9 over five games. Keep the setup intact until new candidate evidence passes its gates. Prioritize diagnosis of the isolated 1590ms report and validate whether shots in the report correspond to SHOOT commands; no claim of candidate improvement.
